name: J M Mold South Inc
old_description: We’ve been refining this idea since 1986, when David M. Bowers founded the company as JM Mold South. In 2008, Dave’s son and daughter joined senior management — David M. Bowers II became CEO and Michelle Powell became COO.
about:
J M Mold South Inc., doing business as JMMS, was founded in 1986 by David M. Bowers in Easley, South Carolina. The family-owned company transitioned to second-generation leadership in 2008 when Bowers' son, David M. Bowers II, became chief executive officer and his daughter, Michelle Powell, became chief operating officer. The firm maintains its headquarters in Easley and operates engineering and tool-making facilities in Dong Guan, China.

JMMS provides total program management for die casting and injection molding tooling, covering thermoplastic injection molding, thermoset injection and compression/transfer molding, and die cast tooling. Its services span design validation, concurrent engineering, Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), project management, troubleshooting, and mold maintenance. The company uses a Cimatron 13.0 CAD/CAM platform to integrate communications, collaboration, and program management across its global operations.

The company serves original equipment manufacturers and Tier vendors in the automotive, medical technology, and consumer products sectors. In consumer products, JMMS has produced molded components for microwaves, mixers, blenders, refrigerators, icemakers, and air deflection systems. A 2016 partnership with the Moldetipo Group expanded its reach into the global automotive market.

JMMS emphasizes single-source accountability, combining design, engineering, manufacturing, and maintenance under one roof. The company states that its next-generation tooling approach delivers standardized, repeatable processes that meet OEM quality benchmarks and lead times while lowering total cost of ownership, backed by an ISO 9001:2015 registered quality management system.
